note: Primary: Croteam's Steam post 'Price Adjustment for The Talos Principle 2' (28 Oct 22:01Z): base price $29.99 to $39.99, regional prices adjusted, rising development and support costs and inflation, owners unaffected. Pictures: Release Date trailer robot face, launch trailer robots.
